biological.citation: Inhibition of neutrophil extracellular traps alleviates blood-brain barrier disruption and cognitive dysfunction via Wnt3/β-catenin/TCF4 signaling in sepsis-associated encephalopathy (PMID: 40102948)
biological.summary: TCF4 is a downstream component of the Wnt3/β-catenin signaling pathway that mediates blood-brain barrier integrity through regulation of tight junction proteins (Occludin) and adherens junction complexes (VCL/β-catenin/VE-cadherin). NETs inhibition increases TCF4-mediated signaling to promote BBB protection and cognitive function recovery in a CLP-induced sepsis-associated encephalopathy mouse model.
biological.sample_size: CLP-induced SAE mice model with Transwell co-culture system
biological.significance: p<0.05 for multiple endpoints including cognitive function and BBB integrity markers

biological.citation: Class I HDAC inhibitors enhance antitumor efficacy and persistence of CAR-T cells by activation of the Wnt pathway (PMID: 38578828)
biological.summary: TCF4 expression is upregulated by class I HDAC inhibitors (M344, chidamide) in CAR-T cells through increased H3K27ac activity. TCF4, along with LEF1 and CTNNB1, activates the canonical Wnt/β-catenin pathway to enhance CAR-T cell memory maintenance and resistance to exhaustion, demonstrated by multi-omics analyses (RNA-seq, ATAC-seq, H3K27ac CUT&Tag-seq).
biological.sample_size: In vitro CAR-T cell cultures and in vivo tumor models
biological.significance: Multi-omics confirmed upregulation of TCF4 and pathway activation

biological.citation: FOXP3 promotes tumor growth and metastasis by activating Wnt/β-catenin signaling pathway and EMT in non-small cell lung cancer (PMID: 28716029)
biological.summary: TCF4 physically interacts with β-catenin and FOXP3 to enhance transcription of Wnt target genes (c-Myc, Cyclin D1) and promote cell proliferation, invasion, and EMT in NSCLC. Co-immunoprecipitation demonstrated direct FOXP3-β-catenin-TCF4 complex formation that drives oncogenic transcription.
biological.sample_size: 106 NSCLC patients, NSCLC cell lines, mouse xenograft models
biological.significance: High FOXP3 associated with decreased overall survival and recurrence-free survival (p<0.05)

biological.citation: Liquidambaric acid inhibits Wnt/β-catenin signaling and colon cancer via targeting TNF receptor-associated factor 2 (PMID: 35108540)
biological.summary: TCF4 is a component of a TRAF2/β-catenin/TCF4/TNIK complex in colon cancer cells where TRAF2 mediates β-catenin/TCF4 interactions essential for Wnt signaling activation. Liquidambaric acid disrupts TRAF2/β-catenin and β-catenin/TCF4 interactions to inhibit oncogenic Wnt signaling.
biological.sample_size: Colon cancer cell lines and in vivo xenograft models
biological.significance: Demonstrated disruption of protein complexes and inhibition of Wnt signaling in vitro and in vivo

biological.citation: Transcription Factor 4 loss-of-function is associated with deficits in progenitor proliferation and cortical neuron content (PMID: 35501322)
biological.summary: TCF4 loss-of-function in patient-derived neural progenitor cells from Pitt-Hopkins Syndrome individuals results in reduced proliferation and impaired neuronal differentiation through decreased Wnt signaling and reduced SOX gene expression. TCF4 correction or Wnt pathway modulation rescues progenitor proliferation and cortical neuron content in patient-derived organoids.
biological.sample_size: Patient-derived iPSC-derived neural progenitor cells and brain organoids from Pitt-Hopkins Syndrome children
biological.significance: Phenotypes rescued by TCF4 correction or Wnt pathway modulation

biological.citation: STING-mediated IL-6 Inhibits OATP1B1 Expression via the TCF4 Signaling Pathway in Cholestasis (PMID: 39130625)
biological.summary: TCF4 is a downstream regulator of the β-catenin/TCF4 complex that controls OATP1B1 expression in hepatocytes. IL-6 downregulates β-catenin/TCF4 expression, leading to decreased OATP1B1 and impaired bile acid/bilirubin transport in cholestatic disease. Knockdown of β-catenin/TCF4 confirms its role in OATP1B1 regulation.
biological.sample_size: Cholestatic mouse model, PLC/PRF/5 and HepG2 hepatocellular carcinoma cell lines
biological.significance: IL-6 treatment significantly decreased TCF4 and OATP1B1 expression (p<0.05)

biological.citation: Psychiatric risk gene Transcription Factor 4 (TCF4) regulates the density and connectivity of distinct inhibitory interneuron subtypes (PMID: 37770578)
biological.summary: TCF4 is a critical regulator of GABAergic interneuron development, with single-cell sequencing showing high TCF4 expression in inhibitory interneurons. Tcf4+/tr Pitt-Hopkins Syndrome mice show reductions in parvalbumin+, VIP+, and cortistatin+ interneurons in cortex and cholinergic interneurons in striatum, leading to altered excitatory-inhibitory balance and network dysfunction.
biological.sample_size: Tcf4+/tr mouse model of PTHS with immunohistochemistry and reporter mice
biological.significance: Significant reductions in specific interneuron populations identified by IHC and cell-type specific analysis

biological.citation: MeCP2 gene therapy ameliorates disease phenotype in mouse model for Pitt Hopkins syndrome (PMID: 38876822)
biological.summary: TCF4 mutations in patient-derived induced neuronal progenitor cells and astrocytes show functional deficits in differentiation and proliferation. MeCP2 levels are decreased in PTHS patient iNPCs, and genetic or viral-mediated MeCP2 overexpression in Tcf4+/- mice ameliorates molecular and behavioral defects, revealing convergent pathways between TCF4 and MeCP2 in neurodevelopmental disorders.
biological.sample_size: Patient skin-derived fibroblasts reprogrammed to iNPCs and iAstrocytes; Tcf4+/- mice crossed with MeCP2-overexpressing mice
biological.significance: Significant amelioration of histological and behavioral defects with MeCP2 gene therapy

biological.citation: WNT2B high-expressed fibroblasts induce the fibrosis of IBD by promoting NK cells secreting IL-33 (PMID: 39138828)
biological.summary: TCF4, a downstream component of the WNT/β-catenin pathway, binds to p65 (NF-κB) and promotes binding to the IL-33 promoter to enhance IL-33 expression in NK cells. WNT2B-activated fibroblasts promote IL-33 secretion through TCF4-mediated transcription, contributing to intestinal inflammation and fibrosis in IBD.
biological.sample_size: IBD patient tissues and colitis mouse model
biological.significance: Salinomycin (WNT/β-catenin inhibitor) significantly reduced IL-33 secretion and intestinal inflammation

biological.citation: ASHG 2023 - Deciphering the genetic architecture of autism spectrum disorder using chromosomal microarray and whole exome sequencing in patient-parent trios in India (J. Shah et al.)
biological.summary: TCF4 was identified as one of the major de novo SNV-containing genes in autism spectrum disorder patients from Indian population, with 90% of WES-identified variants being SNVs. TCF4 mutations were among the most frequently detected genes associated with ASD, alongside MECP2, SCN2A, and CNTNAP2.
biological.sample_size: 101 patient-parent trios with ASD from India; 30 trios received genetic diagnosis from WES
biological.significance: 29.7% diagnostic yield from WES; TCF4 identified in de novo variants with 66.6% de novo inheritance pattern

biological.citation: Transcription factor TCF4: structure, function, and associated diseases (PMID: 39722673)
biological.summary: TCF4 is a basic helix-loop-helix transcription factor crucial for nervous system development and functioning. TCF4 can be expressed in multiple isoforms due to complex gene structure and regulation. The protein functions in transcriptional regulation of target genes involved in neurodevelopment, with pathogenic variants causing Pitt-Hopkins Syndrome and polymorphic variants associated with psychiatric disorders including schizophrenia.
biological.significance: Comprehensive review of TCF4 structure, function, and disease associations
